facts.fact: 第二天是 Lucinda 的法庭日，Celia 将正式收养她；当天下午 Celia 有紧急寄养安置，Gomolinskis、Mama 和 Alba 的「当下自我」在 Celia 与 Lucinda 家做饭、布置派对
facts.anchor: Tomorrow is Lucinda’s court date, the long-awaited day when Celia can finally adopt her.

facts.fact: Alba 的「现在」本该是 2044 年 5 月一个寒冷雨夜，跟 Zach 与 Rosa 打拼字游戏；她却在这里陪 Lucinda 跑最后的差事
facts.anchor: playing Scrabble with Zach and Rosa on a cold, rainy evening in May 2044

facts.fact: Lucinda 16 岁，最近又长了个子，身高 5 英尺 10 英寸、臀部更丰满，裙子必须改过；Alba 看着她试衣，庆幸她「还是个孩子」
facts.anchor: she’s suddenly 5'10" and a little more filled-out around the hips

facts.fact: 两人在街角买冰淇淋（Lucinda 黄油山核桃、Alba 薄荷巧克力碎），沿 Bryn Mawr 向西走；Lucinda 怕上法庭，说「Court is just a place where I don’t have much say in my own life」
facts.anchor: Lucinda is nervous about going to court tomorrow.

facts.fact: Lucinda 决定保留自己的姓 Flowers（Celia 问过她是否要改成 Attley），理由是父母留给她的只剩名字
facts.anchor: it’s just that I hardly have anything left of my parents, except my name.

facts.fact: 父母 Jasmine 与 Malcolm 同一天去世（墓碑上都是 2-10-2014），死于去晚宴路上买酒时撞上的酒铺抢劫；Alba 2013 年曾时间旅行去警告他们，没有用
facts.anchor: They were killed in a liquor store robbery gone wrong

facts.fact: 祖母（Jasmine 的母亲）与两个舅舅在一年后死于疑似煤气泄漏的火灾；Lucinda 当时在同学家第一次 sleepover，父亲一侧无人能接，于是进了寄养系统、到 Celia 家
facts.anchor: a year later there was a fire, probably from a gas leak

facts.fact: 回到家屋里已坐满人，Charisse 做了柠檬水；Lucinda 皱着眉安静看大家，说「Don’t worry, Alba. It’s all good」，Alba 反而因此起了疑
facts.anchor: I didn’t doubt her until she reassured me.
